decisionsTitle: The registrations Excel ends with a statistics block: the total, the states, the club's runners and the categories (amending §172 and §581)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-15, from his phone:** «last in queue: the Excel should have a statistics footer so that I can show „how many Brașov Runners”, how many active, etc., grouped by category». His standing word on the open points was «YOLO»: they are decided below, each with its reason, and the owner may turn any of them over.

**What it is.** Under the registrations spreadsheet, after one empty row, a block «Statistici» (Română) / «Statistics» (English, the list's `lang` as for «Note interne») that counts the rows the file carries. Since §581 the file is the rows on screen, so every filter of the list narrows the block with the table; a test registration is never in the file (§30) and so in no number. Bold labels in the header's own style, every count a number cell (it sums and sorts), the block starting in the table's first column. The spreadsheet only: **the CSV stays rows only**, because a footer in a comma-separated file is read by every script and import as registrations.

**Where it sits.** The sheet declares no autofilter and no Excel table — the header is only kept on screen (§172) — so there is no range for a footer to be inside of; the empty row is the separation, and it is what Excel's own «current region» stops at, so sorting the list from a selected cell never drags the block. Declaring an autofilter (the library supports none) was refused: it would be a feature nobody asked for, written to defend a footer.

**What is counted.** One line each for the total; the confirmed; waiting for the address to be confirmed; waiting for the declaration; on the waiting list; offered a place; cancelled; expired — seven states that add up to the total, so nothing is hidden inside a «pending»; then the club's runners, the club's confirmed ones, and «Alții, nu {club}». Under them a small table, one row per category, with the columns total, confirmed, the club's, the club's confirmed.

**«Activ» means confirmed** — BUSINESS.md's vocabulary: a participant is confirmed once the declaration is signed and a place is held, which is the person who will stand on the start line. The code's «active» (`ACTIVE_REGISTRATION_STATUSES`) also holds the pending and the offered, because those hold a place for a while; that is a capacity word, not a count the club shows a sponsor. The block says it in a sentence under the numbers.

**«Brașov Runners» is any of three signals**, the ones the list already shows, so the block cannot say what the rows above do not: the address is a live member account on «Echipa» (`verified`, §662); the person ticked «Sunt membru al grupului» (`declared`, §662); or the free-text club they typed names the club in any spelling the public list accepts (`namesTheClub`, §753 and §766: «Runners Brașov», «BVR», «Clubul Brașov Runners (BVR)»; never «Brașov Runners Cluj»). The union, not one signal: the club's runners have no accounts to be sure by (§756), and the owner wants to show how many they are. It is a count for the club's own use, never a verdict on a person. The club's name comes from the platform's constant (§357), never from a catalogue.

**A category is the sex and an age band** on the race day (`ageOnRaceDay`, §322): the club has defined no categories of its own (the events have none), and BUSINESS.md names the sex and the age counted on the race as what race categories are made of. The bands are the ordinary ones of a road race — under 18 (an event's minimum age is 14, §515), 18–29, 30–39, 40–49, 50–59, 60 and over — women first as on the form (§555), youngest first; an empty category is not written. A row missing either answer (the retired «Prefer să nu spun», a staff entry with no sex or birth date) is counted under «Fără categorie», never guessed into one. The bands are a constant in `statistics.ts`; the club can ask for others.

**Several events.** When the file holds more than one event (the list's «Toate evenimentele», or a search across them), the block is counted per event first — each with its own states, club and categories, by event id so two runs with one title are two groups, in the order the events start, labelled with the title and the day on the event's own clock — and once more over all of them at the end. The block's title is written once.

**Refused.** A footer in the CSV; an autofilter or a table to defend the footer; a second sheet (the owner asked for a footer under the rows); counting by one signal only (the member account alone would show almost nobody); a button or a switch to leave the footer out (it is under the rows and a sort never takes it); a new dependency; a migration (everything is read from what the file already carries).

**Tests that moved.** The notes' integration tests read the export's rows through `startListRows`, which stops at the empty row, so they still read the start list and not the footer.
changelogLine: - **A statistics footer in the registrations Excel** — under the rows, after one empty row, «Statistici» counts what the file carries: the total, the confirmed (the active ones), every other state, how many are Brașov Runners (a member, the ticked box or the typed club) and how many are not, and one row per category (sex and age band) — per event first when the file holds several, in the list's language, never in the CSV. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the registrations export in Excel, when a role that may read the registrations downloads it, then under the rows, after one empty row and outside any filter or sort range (the sheet declares none), a bold block «Statistici» («Statistics» with the list's language English) counts the rows of the file as number cells — the total; the confirmed, the pending on the address, the pending on the declaration, the waiting list, the waiting-list offers, the cancelled and the expired; the club's runners (a member account, the ticked box or a typed club that names the club), the club's confirmed and the others — and, per category (the sex and the age band on the race day: under 18, 18–29, 30–39, 40–49, 50–59, 60 and over, or no category), the total, the confirmed, the club's and the club's confirmed; the filters apply and a test registration is in no count; a file of several events is counted per event in the order they start and then over all of them; the CSV carries no footer (2026-10-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `registrations/statistics-footer.test.ts`; integration `registrations/statistics-footer.test.ts`; e2e `statistics-footer.spec.ts`.
